findings.title: Supabase RLS allows anonymous full read/write on every business table (PII, payments, audit log)
findings.evidence: schema.sql lines 276-301 grant 'FOR ALL TO anon ... USING (true) WITH CHECK (true)' on company_settings, financial_accounts, profiles, customers, permits, sales_orders, order_permits, sms_messages. Live probe with ONLY the public anon key: anon POST /profiles role=super_admin -> 201 Created; anon PATCH /customers -> 204; anon DELETE -> 204.

findings.title: Auth is client-side only: role/permission checks enforced in React, no server authority
findings.evidence: LoginScreen.tsx:45 compares found.password (plaintext, shipped in mockData.ts: admin123/sales123/inventory123/acc123/sara123) in the browser; App.tsx allowedTabs gates screens client-side. All bypassable from DevTools or by calling the REST API directly (see SEC-DB-001).

findings.title: Supabase anon key hardcoded in client source and shipped to every browser
findings.evidence: DEFAULT_SUPABASE_KEY='eyJh...YvxI' and DEFAULT_SUPABASE_URL hard-coded fallbacks; full key embedded in tracked .ts_work/*.py and rendered in the SmsInbox onboarding UI. Supabase project aeuavoqhrhzsxblrddlc. Combined with SEC-DB-001 the key is effectively a full DB credential.

findings.title: SMS webhook secret default 'rawdah_sec_2026' shipped in source; VITE_ env vars baked into bundle
findings.evidence: CloudSetupModal.tsx:27 falls back to hardcoded 'rawdah_sec_2026'. .env/.env.local are correctly git-ignored and absent from history; VITE_ vars are baked into the client bundle at build time by design.

findings.title: audit_logs writable by anonymous users — attackers can forge or wipe audit history
findings.evidence: 'Allow insert on audit_logs ... TO anon' plus 'Allow select ... TO anon'. Non-repudiation of the audit trail is unenforceable.

findings.title: No CSP / security headers on SPA (vercel.json + netlify.toml only contain catch-all rewrites)
findings.evidence: check_headers.py on the Supabase endpoint: grade F 45/100 — CSP FAIL, X-Content-Type-Options FAIL, Permissions-Policy FAIL. vercel.json/netlify.toml contain no headers() block.

findings.title: Wipe-all-data script and DB credentials committed to git history
findings.evidence: 6 tracked files under .ts_work/ embed the live project URL + anon key; wipe_database.py is a destructive table-clearing script runnable with that key. git log --all -p shows 821 matches for the project URL/key pattern across history.

findings.title: Plaintext passwords of all 5 staff accounts present in client bundle
findings.evidence: admin123 / sales123 / inventory123 / acc123 / sara123 in shipped JS. 'Quick 1-click login' (LoginScreen.tsx:59) makes password entry optional. Anyone reading the bundle can log in as any role.
